newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for two bln lire of Italy CCTs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for two bln lire of Italy CCTs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated 2.0 billion lire of seven-year variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 500 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 9.977 trillion lire at the open auction for a third tranche of the January 1, 2004 certificates, against 5.0 trillion lire worth on offer.
The auction price was set at 100.30 from 100.65 at the previous CCT sale on January 15. The gross yield was 7.05 percent against 6.79 percent.
